_README: Stage 1 article plan. swamps = hypothesis-grade terrain map (the dossier cold-mine may re-rank). Per article: swamp + handoff (turn|seed|none) and the Stage 1c opportunity verdict. REJECT rows are kept as a record and are NOT written. Titles are working titles: any named product, form or rule in a title is confirmed in Stage 2 before it is written.

swamps.name: Where to base, and how to split the nights
swamps.one_liner: Bali drives far bigger than it looks on a map; the base you pick decides what is realistically reachable each day.

swamps.name: Planning days around south Bali traffic
swamps.one_liner: Distances are short and drive times are not; an over-packed day or a late airport run is the classic first-timer failure.

swamps.name: Which season for which Bali
swamps.one_liner: Rain, surf coasts, crowds and prices all move with the calendar, and they do not all point at the same month.

swamps.name: Scooter, driver, or both
swamps.one_liner: The cheap way around carries a licence and insurance chain that most renters only discover after a crash.

swamps.name: Nusa and Gili boats, and what sits next to them
swamps.one_liner: Fast boats depend on sea conditions; where the island leg falls relative to the flight home is the decision.

swamps.name: Trip dates against the Balinese calendar
swamps.one_liner: Some days close the island outright and others close roads and fill hotels; they move every year.

swamps.name: The pre-flight paperwork stack
swamps.one_liner: Visa, levy, arrival form and passport rules are separate systems with separate sites, and each is easy to miss.

swamps.name: Getting there from the US, and the first 48 hours
swamps.one_liner: There is a long connection either way; the routing, ticket type and first-night base decide how much of the trip is lost.

swamps.name: Stomach, medication, clinics, insurance
swamps.one_liner: Each piece is manageable alone; what a traveler needs is how they connect when something goes wrong.

swamps.name: Cash, cards and where the money leaks
swamps.one_liner: ATMs, changers, surcharges and tax-plus-service each take a little; together they set the real budget.
